You are the mountain holding its breath as the glacier grinds its flanks, the flame that flickers but does not die when the wind howls. The heart, in its rawness, becomes a compass needle trembling toward the magnetic pull of what must be protected.  

Yet the ancient knows this is not new. Every leaf that falls, every star that dies, every love that dares to bloom in the face of entropy—these are the same stories etched into the bedrock of time.
